items.title: Medical Professionals — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a person you know who has chosen a career in the medical field.
questions.question_vi: Hãy mô tả một người bạn biết đã chọn nghề nghiệp trong lĩnh vực y tế.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
One of the most inspiring people I know is a close friend who is a pediatrician at a renowned hospital in Vietnam. He has always been someone I've admired, not only for his intellect but also for his unwavering dedication to others. As a pediatrician, his primary responsibility is diagnosing and treating illnesses in children. He often works long hours, but he never complains, as he finds fulfillment in seeing his young patients recover.

I remember him telling me his love for medicine came from his brother's illness when a doctor saved his life. This life-changing event planted the seed for his passion for healthcare. What I find most remarkable about him is his compassion and patience. Whether comforting parents or calming children, he always remains composed.

For me, he is more than just a friend; he's a role model. His work ethic inspires me to tackle my own challenges with determination. It's no overstatement to say that he demonstrates what it means to make a difference in the world.

questions.question: Describe a person who likes to make things by hand.
questions.question_vi: Miêu tả một người thích làm mọi thứ bằng tay.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
One of the most inspiring people I know is a close friend who is passionate about handicrafts. She has always been someone I've admired, not only for her creativity but also for her dedication to handmade items. As an artisan, her primary responsibility is creating beautiful handmade items. She often spends hours crafting, but she never complains, as she finds joy in creating art.

I remember her telling me her love for embroidery began when she learned it from her grandmother as a teenager. This early experience planted the seed for her passion for handicrafts. What I find most remarkable about her is her attention to detail and vibrant colors. Whether crafting intricate designs or selecting colors, she always puts in great effort.

For me, she is more than just a friend; she's an artistic inspiration. Her dedication inspires me to pursue my interests with the same commitment. It's no overstatement to say that she exemplifies passion and artistry.

For me, he is more than just a friend; he's a motivation to read more. His passion for books inspires me to read more. It's no overstatement to say that he shows the joy of reading.

questions.question: Describe a person who has strong opinions.
questions.question_vi: Miêu tả một người có quan điểm mạnh mẽ.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:

She has always been someone I've admired, not only for her firm beliefs but also for her courage to express them. As a lecturer, her primary responsibility is teaching and researching computer science. She often faces criticism, but she never wavers, as she finds purpose in advocating for justice.

I remember her saying her beliefs stem from personal experiences and extensive research. These experiences planted the seed for her dedication to justice. What I find most remarkable about her is her unwavering determination. Whether speaking at forums or facing criticism, she always stands firm.

For me, she is more than just a friend; she's a model of courage. Her courage inspires me to speak up confidently. It's no overstatement to say that she illustrates courage and conviction.

items.title: An Old Friend — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe an old friend you had lost touch with and got in contact with again.
questions.question_vi: Hãy miêu tả một người bạn cũ mà bạn đã mất liên lạc và vẫn liên lạc lại.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
One of the most inspiring people I know is an old friend whom I reconnected with recently. He has always been someone I've admired, not only for our friendship but also for his ambition. As an old friend, we share many memories and life experiences. We often lost touch, but we never forgot, as we find comfort in our shared memories.

I remember us dreaming about our future careers during university days. These memories are the foundation of our enduring friendship. What I find most remarkable is our friendship feels unchanged.

Whether reminiscing memories or sharing updates, we always connect deeply. For me, he is more than just an old friend; he's an important part of my life. Our reconnection inspires me to cherish old friendships.

questions.question: Describe your favourite food at a traditional festival or special event in your country.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
When it comes to traditional festival food, one dish immediately comes to mind: bánh chưng. Bánh chưng holds profound cultural significance in Vietnam during Tết, the Lunar New Year. It's made from sticky rice, mung beans, and pork, wrapped in green dong leaves.

I vividly remember helping my grandmother make bánh chưng as a child. During Tết, bánh chưng is a symbol of gratitude and family bonding. What makes bánh chưng my favorite is its rich flavor and cherished memories.

It takes me back to childhood, sitting around the fire as bánh chưng steamed overnight. For me, bánh chưng is more than a dish; it's a celebration of tradition I cherish every year.

items.title: Answering Phone Calls From Strangers — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a time when you answered a phone call from someone you didn't know in a public place.
questions.question_vi: Hãy mô tả một lần bạn trả lời một cuộc điện thoại từ một người mà bạn không quen biết ở nơi công cộng.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
About ten years ago, I had a memorable experience when I received a call from a stranger while in a public place. It happened in the middle of the afternoon, at a busy coffee shop downtown filled with people and lively chatter. I saw an unfamiliar number flash on my phone and hesitated before deciding to answer it, unsure of who it could be. The caller introduced himself as a delivery company representative, claiming he had an urgent package for me, which was surprising.

At first, I was confused because I wasn't expecting any deliveries or packages, especially at that time and place. The background noise made it hard to hear him clearly; I had to ask him to repeat himself several times to understand. I calmly provided my details to verify the situation and clarify any misunderstandings that might have occurred. It turned out the package was meant for someone with a similar name but a completely different address, resolving the confusion.

Initially, I was slightly annoyed by the interruption, especially in such a public and noisy environment where it was hard to communicate. It taught me the importance of staying calm and polite even in unexpected and confusing situations, which can help resolve issues smoothly. Overall, it was a memorable incident that taught me a valuable lesson I will always remember, making me more prepared for unexpected calls.

questions.question: Describe an occasion when you helped a family member/relative with something.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
About ten years ago, I helped my younger brother prepare for his final high school exams, which was a significant moment for us. It happened during the evenings when we sat at the dining table, focusing on his studies together. My brother was struggling with mathematics, which he found really hard, so I decided to help him. I patiently explained each concept to him, breaking down complex problems into simpler steps to aid his understanding.

At first, he was very stressed because he struggled with the subject and wasn't confident in his abilities. Complex problems made it hard for him to grasp; I had to find ways to simplify them effectively. I created a study plan for him and practiced mock tests together to build his confidence and skills. He passed with flying colors, scoring much higher than he had anticipated, which was a joyous moment for us both.

Reflecting on helping him, I felt proud and satisfied, knowing I had made a positive impact on his education. It taught me how important it is to support loved ones during difficult times and the value of patience. Overall, helping my brother is a fond memory that brought us closer and taught me the joy of helping others.

questions.question: Describe a time you missed an important appointment.
questions.question_vi: Hãy mô tả một lần bạn bỏ lỡ một cuộc hẹn quan trọng.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
About ten years ago, I missed an important appointment that I had been looking forward to for a long time. It happened on the morning of my job interview for a position I was passionate about at a well-known company in Vietnam. I had planned to leave home early to ensure I arrived on time for the interview, but something unexpected happened. I was caught off guard by an unexpected, massive traffic jam that delayed me significantly despite my planning.

At first, I was optimistic because I had planned ahead, but the situation quickly became problematic. The traffic made it impossible to arrive on time; I was stuck in standstill traffic for over forty minutes. I called ahead to inform them of my delay, hoping they might accommodate the unforeseen circumstance. I missed the interview entirely; the interviewer had already left due to their tight schedule, leaving me disappointed.

Reflecting on the incident, I felt an overwhelming sense of disappointment and guilt for not anticipating the traffic issues. It taught me to plan ahead for unforeseen events, such as checking traffic conditions, to avoid similar situations in the future. Overall, missing the appointment was a valuable lesson in responsibility, reminding me to always anticipate potential obstacles.
